description:
## Proven problem

During the fz-tfn.26 current-base 502-test fixture matrix, matrix::spec_violation::run failed once because its temporary telemetry file was missing under parallel execution. The isolated test passed unchanged and the second parallel matrix did not reproduce it. This is a test-harness file lifecycle race, not compiler semantics.

## Goal

Make every parallel fixture invocation the sole owner of a unique telemetry path from creation through final read and cleanup.

## Strategy

Trace path generation, child completion, telemetry flush/read, and cleanup. Encode uniqueness and lifetime at the harness boundary; do not mask missing files with retries or optional reads. Consider the existing parallel AOT archive race ticket only for shared patterns, not as ownership of this distinct telemetry failure.

## TDD

Run many concurrent spec_violation fixture invocations with asserted unique paths and complete readable telemetry after child completion, then stress the full parallel fixture matrix.

## Acceptance

No missing, reused, prematurely removed, or partially read telemetry file under repeated parallel stress. No sleep, timeout increase, retry, ignored error, or compiler behavior change. Document the temp-artifact ownership contract.
title: Give parallel fixture telemetry files collision-free lifecycle ownership
